What is in the counter

From the shop photos and what guests write in their Google reviews.

Pastries

Eclairs, kok, millefeuille and daktyla, all named by guests in their reviews.

Cakes and tarts

Chocolate cakes in the cooler, fruit tarts with kiwi and orange, and desserts in jars.

In the morning

Open from 7:30 on weekdays. One guest tips the small, crunchy olive pies in the morning.

What guests say

Three of 44 Google reviews, 40 of them with five stars.

Google review
